phases.objective: Run the canonical mounted Tenant-route suite and durable control-plane repository suite in one fail-closed runner, validate both structured safety contracts, and explicitly avoid claiming that the suites share one operation state or complete the parent Spec 014 MVP.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The independent mounted-route and durable-repository suites both return their expected secret-free structured gates; the result remains contract-level evidence and does not promote the parent Spec 014 MVP.
steps: Run the mounted Tenant HTTP route suite in an isolated child process and require its exact structured gate.
Validate Context Kernel, effective-authority, expected-SHA, request-injection, Admin, cross-Tenant, one-shot enablement, and Tenant-safe projection assertions from the route suite.
Run the durable control-plane repository suite in a separate isolated child process and require its exact structured gate.
Validate immutable-plan, append-only approval, CAS lease, restart-safe journal, single-use plan, and unknown-outcome retry assertions from the repository suite.
Fail closed if either child suite exits non-zero, emits no structured report, changes its gate identity, reports secrets, permits provider dispatch, or claims Production readiness.
Declare that no shared operation instance or shared repository state is passed between the two child suites and that the parent feature remains blocked pending a real shared-state journey.
assertions: Both canonical child suites pass under one bounded fail-closed runner.
The mounted route and durable repository reports remain independently attributable.
The evidence is contract convergence only; shared_operation_state is false.
The parent feature 014-governed-hostinger-storage-orchestration is not promoted by this gate.
Provider dispatch, live mutation, SQL apply, deployment, Production readiness, and secrets remain disabled.

phases.objective: Add a composable shared-state test seam that executes one mounted request through the canonical durable repository, journal, reconciliation, and Tenant-safe readback before considering parent MVP promotion.
Extend the future shared-state journey with fault injection, worker restart recovery, and checkpoint restoration.
Run the future shared-state journey against one separately authorized non-production Tenant target.
This bounded contract-convergence gate grants no live, deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority.
